findings.ac: All ACs / pytest tests/workflows tests/lifecycle passes
findings.text: The slice adds or changes no tests. None of the behavior ACs is proven by a test: 3c never proposes status:planned for a Spike, 3b births Spikes at vX.Y.0, and 3d (Phase 0 step 0 Spike guard) and 3z (preflight status:needs_spec skip) refuse Spikes. The new dispatch.py select_eligible exclusion of status:needs_spec is also untested. The 'pytest passes' AC only shows pre-existing tests still run.

findings.ac: Change: 3c Spikes sized size:medium (3h), share 80h budget
findings.text: The issue body says Spikes are sized size:medium (3h). 3c-sprint-planning Phase 3 instead sets a flat 5h Spike timebox regardless of size:, and issue-templates.md says Spikes carry no size: label. The implemented value (5h) contradicts the stated spec (3h) with no recorded deviation.

findings.ac: Change: unlabelled priority sorts last, BT number fallback
findings.text: The issue says unlabelled priority sorts last with BT number as fallback. 3c Phase 2 sorts on scope (unlabelled scope last), then Build before Spike, then ICE desc or Spike BT ascending. Priority-label ordering is not implemented as described, so the spec and the 3c text diverge.

3b Phase 3 step 5 only sets the BACKLOG_MAP milestone to vX.Y.0 ('Spikes too'). Step 4 gh issue create has no explicit GitHub milestone assignment, so the GitHub-side birth milestone for Spikes is not stated, only the BACKLOG mirror. Untested too.

findings.ac: 3d and 3z refuse to run a Spike (simulation test)
findings.text: tests/workflows/test_3z_orchestrator_simulation.py (Step 2A.1) still asserts a gh issue edit that removes status:needs_spec, while 3d step 2 no longer does. The simulation is hardcoded and not tied to the docs, so it cannot catch a Spike-refusal regression and is now stale against 3d.
